source.digestAlgorithm: SHA-256 of sorted tracked app/server/package.json/package-lock.json/nuxt.config.ts paths, each path and file content followed by a NUL byte.

baseline.byteScope: Git object bytes; working-tree line endings may differ. The changed-file inventory uses Git changes rather than line-ending-only byte differences.

source.providerBoundary: The current UI browser runs did not repeat real-provider checks; prior real OpenAI evidence retains its own application digest.

boundaries: These are finite local browser and geometric checks, not universal accessibility or production validation.
No institutional SSO, real applicant data, payroll, hosted deployment or physical-device validation is established.
The UI boundary checks unchanged Vue script ASTs and button counts separately from browser behavior and geometry.
